records.jp: よーし！　それじゃあ、さっそく始めよう
records.en_original: Okay! Let's get started!
records.en: Okay! Let's get started!

records.jp: 始めようって……なにすんの？
records.en_original: Get started? What're we doing?
records.en: Get started? What're we doing?

records.jp: ふっふーん！<CR>じゃーん、これ見て！
records.en_original: Hehe! Ta-da! Take a look!
records.en: Hehe! Ta-da! Take a look!

records.jp: うわ、綺麗な石！<CR>どうしたのこれ？
records.en_original: Wow, they're beautiful! Where did you find them?
records.en: Wow, they're beautiful! Where did you find them?

records.jp: なんの石かは分からないけど、<CR>落ちてるのを、拾い集めてたんだ
records.en_original: I just picked them up off the ground. I'm not sure what kind of stones they are, though.
records.en: I just picked them up off the ground. I'm not sure what kind of stones they are, though.

records.jp: へぇー……<CR>クリスタルみたいに、キラキラしてる
records.en_original: Ooh... They're so shiny, like crystals.
records.en: Ooh... They're so shiny, like crystals.

records.jp: せっかくだから、この石を使って<CR>ストラップでも作ろうと思って
records.en_original: I thought we could make key chains out of them!
records.en: I thought we could make key chains out of them!

records.jp: おお、ハンドメイドってやつですな
records.en_original: Ohh, like handmade ones?
records.en: Ohh, like handmade ones?

records.jp: それですな！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: 上手く出来るかなあ……
records.en_original: That looks hard...
records.en: That looks hard...

records.jp: こういうのは、直感でいいんだよ！
records.en_original: You just have to trust your intuition!
records.en: You just have to trust your intuition!

records.jp: それに、愛央ちゃんなら<CR>きっと可愛いのができると思う！
records.en_original: I'm sure you'll make a really cute one, Ao.
records.en: I'm sure you'll make a really cute one, Ao.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんに言われると<CR>出来そうな気がしてきた！
records.en_original: Thanks, Hiori. You gave me the confidence boost I need!
records.en: Thanks, Hiori. You gave me the confidence boost I need!

records.jp: よーし、やってみるかあ！
records.en_original: All right then, let's give it a try!
records.en: All right then, let's give it a try!

records.jp: 完成後が楽しみだね！
records.en_original: I can't wait to see them when they're done!
records.en: I can't wait to see them when they're done!

records.jp: うん！<CR>二人で、可愛いの作ろう！
records.en_original: Yeah! I bet they'll be really cute!
records.en: Yeah! I bet they'll be really cute!

records.jp: 可愛いのかあ……<CR>私、あんまりセンスないんだよなー
records.en_original: Cute, huh... I've never really had a good eye for that kind of thing.
records.en: Cute, huh... I've never really had a good eye for that kind of thing.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんが、いいなーと思ったのを<CR>作ればいいんだよ
records.en_original: Just go with what looks good to you, Ao.
records.en: Just go with what looks good to you, Ao.

records.jp: それに、大事なのは気持ちでしょ？
records.en_original: Besides, it's the feeling you put into it that's important, right?
records.en: Besides, it's the feeling you put into it that's important, right?

records.jp: そうだね。<CR>とりあえず、やってみよっか！
records.en_original: You're right. Let's give it a try!
records.en: You're right. Let's give it a try!

records.jp: ここをこうして……イタッ！
records.en_original: Gonna do this here, and...ouch!
records.en: Gonna do this here, and...ouch!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、大丈夫？
records.en_original: Ao, are you all right?
records.en: Ao, are you all right?

records.jp: へーきへーき！<CR>カッターでやっちゃっただけ
records.en_original: I'm fine, I'm fine! The cutter slipped, that's all.
records.en: I'm fine, I'm fine! The cutter slipped, that's all.

records.jp: やだ、血が出てる！<CR>すぐに、消毒した方がいいよ
records.en_original: Oh no, you're bleeding! You should take care of it right away.
records.en: Oh no, you're bleeding! You should take care of it right away.

records.jp: そんな、おおげさな……
records.en_original: It's not that big a deal...
records.en: It's not that big a deal...

records.jp: 小さな怪我でも、放っておいたらダメ。<CR>そこから、ばい菌はいったらどうするの？
records.en_original: You can't just leave a cut untreated, even if it's a small one. What if it gets infected?
records.en: You can't just leave a cut untreated, even if it's a small one. What if it gets infected?

records.jp: たしか、ロッカーに救急箱あったから<CR>持ってくるよ
records.en_original: I think there's a first aid kit in the locker. I'll go get it.
records.en: I think there's a first aid kit in the locker. I'll go get it.

records.jp: うん、ありがとう……
records.en_original: Okay, thanks...
records.en: Okay, thanks...

records.jp: （こういう時、陽桜莉さんって<CR>年上って感じするよね……）
records.en_original: (You can really tell Hiori's the older one in situations like this...)
records.en: (You can really tell Hiori's the older one in situations like this...)

records.jp: じゃあ、陽桜莉さんに消毒してほしいなー
records.en_original: Can you do it for me, Hiori?
records.en: Can you do it for me, Hiori?

records.jp: どういうこと？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: 漫画とかでも、よくあるじゃん。<CR>怪我した指先を、ちゅってするやつ
records.en_original: You know, like you see in comics and stuff. They kiss the wound to make it better.
records.en: You know, like you see in comics and stuff. They kiss the wound to make it better.

records.jp: えっ……えええ！？<CR>で、でも、消毒液の方がいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Wh-whaaat?! D-disinfectant is probably better, don't you think?
records.en: Wh-whaaat?! D-disinfectant is probably better, don't you think?

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、知らないの？<CR>人間の唾液には、強い殺菌能力があるんだよ
records.en_original: Human saliva is a powerful disinfectant. Didn't you know that, Hiori?
records.en: Human saliva is a powerful disinfectant. Didn't you know that, Hiori?

records.jp: （なーんて、冗談だけど）
records.en_original: (Just kidding!)
records.en: (Just kidding!)

records.jp: そっか……そういうことなら……
records.en_original: I see... Then I guess...
records.en: I see... Then I guess...

records.jp: ちょ、マジで！？
records.en_original: Wait, seriously?!
records.en: Wait, seriously?!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんの、ためなら……！
records.en_original: Well, if it's for you, Ao...
records.en: Well, if it's for you, Ao...

records.jp: わー！　ごめん、ごめんなさい！<CR>冗談だから！　信じないで！
records.en_original: Aah! I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I was just joking around! It's not true!
records.en: Aah! I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I was just joking around! It's not true!

records.jp: えっ、冗談なの？
records.en_original: Huh? It was a joke?
records.en: Huh? It was a joke?

records.jp: も～！　愛央ちゃん！！<CR>びっくりさせないでよ～！
records.en_original: Jeez, Ao! You freaked me out!
records.en: Jeez, Ao! You freaked me out!

records.jp: （いや、びっくりしたのこっち！）
records.en_original: (Pretty sure I'm the one who should be saying that!)
records.en: (Pretty sure I'm the one who should be saying that!)

records.jp: ……うん、出来た！
records.en_original: ...There, all done!
records.en: ...There, all done!

records.jp: 私も、完成！
records.en_original: Me too!
records.en: Me too!

records.jp: えへへ、結構可愛く出来た気がする
records.en_original: Eheheh, it's pretty cute if I say so myself.
records.en: Eheheh, it's pretty cute if I say so myself.

records.jp: なんか、陽桜莉さんっぽいよ
records.en_original: It's very you, Hiori.
records.en: It's very you, Hiori.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんのも、愛央ちゃんって感じする
records.en_original: Yours is very you too, Ao.
records.en: Yours is very you too, Ao.

records.jp: でも、上手く出来たから……
records.en_original: You think? It turned out better than I expected, actually...
records.en: You think? It turned out better than I expected, actually...

records.jp: 誰かにあげたいよね
records.en_original: I wanna give it to someone.
records.en: I wanna give it to someone.

records.jp: そうだね。誰にプレゼントしようかな……
records.en_original: That's a good idea. Who should I give mine to...?
records.en: That's a good idea. Who should I give mine to...?

records.jp: やっぱり美弦さんがいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Why not Mio?
records.en: Why not Mio?

records.jp: 確かに、お姉ちゃんこういうの好きそう
records.en_original: You're right, she'd probably love something like this.
records.en: You're right, she'd probably love something like this.

records.jp: けど、やっぱり私は愛央ちゃんにプレゼントしたいかな
records.en_original: But I'd rather give it to you, Ao.
records.en: But I'd rather give it to you, Ao.

records.jp: えっ、私！？
records.en_original: Huh, me?!
records.en: Huh, me?!

records.jp: うん。このところ愛央ちゃんには<CR>ずっとお世話になってるし……
records.en_original: Yeah. You've done so much for me here...
records.en: Yeah. You've done so much for me here...

records.jp: ……受け取ってくれる？
records.en_original: Will you accept this as thanks...?
records.en: Will you accept this as thanks...?

records.jp: もちろん！<CR>そしたら、私のは陽桜莉さんにプレゼントしようかな
records.en_original: Of course! In that case, I'll give you mine too.
records.en: Of course! In that case, I'll give you mine too.

records.jp: えへへ……ありがとう！
records.en_original: Ehehe... Thanks!
records.en: Ehehe... Thanks!

records.jp: ふたりで、交換こしない？
records.en_original: Wanna trade?
records.en: Wanna trade?

records.jp: わあ！　それってすごくいいかも！
records.en_original: Ooh! That's a great idea!
records.en: Ooh! That's a great idea!

records.jp: じゃあ、私のは陽桜莉さんに
records.en_original: Okay then! This is for you, Hiori.
records.en: Okay then! This is for you, Hiori.

records.jp: 私のは、愛央ちゃんに
records.en_original: And this is for you, Ao.
records.en: And this is for you, Ao.

records.jp: ……ふふっ！<CR>嬉しいけど、なんだか照れくさいね
records.en_original: ...Hehe! I'm glad we traded but it's a little embarrassing somehow.
records.en: ...Hehe! I'm glad we traded but it's a little embarrassing somehow.

records.jp: でも、これでいつでも陽桜莉さんと<CR>一緒にいるような気分になれるよ
records.en_original: But now I can feel like you're always with me, Hiori.
records.en: But now I can feel like you're always with me, Hiori.

records.jp: え～、だったら普通に一緒にいようよ。<CR>私、愛央ちゃんとお喋りしたいし
records.en_original: Well...then why don't we just be together? I wanna talk to you, Ao.
records.en: Well...then why don't we just be together? I wanna talk to you, Ao.

records.jp: そりゃ、まあ……<CR>ストラップより本人の方がいいけどさ
records.en_original: Well, yeah... I guess a key chain is no replacement for the real thing.
records.en: Well, yeah... I guess a key chain is no replacement for the real thing.

records.jp: でしょ？
records.en_original: Right?
records.en: Right?

records.jp: （陽桜莉さんって、ほんとに正直だなー）
records.en_original: (Hiori's always so honest, isn't she...)
records.en: (Hiori's always so honest, isn't she...)

records.jp: でも、このストラップも大事にするから！<CR>愛央ちゃん、ありがと！
records.en_original: But I'll keep this key chain near and dear! Thank you, Ao!
records.en: But I'll keep this key chain near and dear! Thank you, Ao!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
